# Remove the default whole-View grid focus outline

## Context

Requested by @tobiu on 2026-09-19 while inspecting the native-speed cell-editing recording: the grid View/Body-sized focus outline should not appear. Reproduced in headed Chromium 153 at `c27c6648f5c56a39828490eda99627e70ca9bb91`, on `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-cell-editing/index.html`, viewport 1400×900.

Click a cell in the upper grid, then press ArrowRight. The active element stays `grid.View`. Pointer modality has `outline-style: none`; keyboard modality paints `2px solid rgb(26,115,232)` around the 1398×386.25 View. All three Bodies retain `outline-style: none`. This is an explicit Neo style, not a browser-default Body ring.

## The Problem

The frame encloses the entire scroll viewport, including the large empty area below the records. The operator requests removal of that default presentation. Keyboard focus ownership and navigation must continue to work.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/scss/src/grid/View.scss` selects `.neo-focus-keyboard:focus` and supplies a hardcoded blue fallback to `--grid-view-focus-outline`.
- Pointer modality already suppresses the frame.
- #15195 intentionally centralized focus and key handling on View and kept Bodies as delegates. Its ownership repair remains correct; this follow-up changes the default visual presentation.

## The Fix

Change the default View outline presentation in the existing stylesheet, retaining the existing custom-property hook for an explicit application/theme override. Update the adjacent comment and affected focus assertions to describe the new default. Preserve View as the keyboard anchor and existing selection/editor focus cues. No new module or API is needed.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Delivered behavior | Compatibility / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Default View focus presentation | Operator direction; `grid/View.scss` | No viewport-sized default outline | Real pointer→keyboard and editor→View paths in both Neo themes |
| Logical focus/key ownership | #15195; `grid.View` | Unchanged View-owned focus, selection and navigation | Active element, selection, edit terminal and scroll-stability assertions |
| `--grid-view-focus-outline` | Existing stylesheet hook | Explicit override remains usable | Override control, without restoring a default full-View frame |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Real keyboard navigation and editor completion/cancellation do not add a default whole-View or Body outline.
- [ ] View retains focus ownership, arrow/Tab behavior and scroll stability.
- [ ] Existing selected-cell/row/column and editor focus cues remain; this is not a global suppression of control focus styling.
- [ ] Explicit custom-property overrides retain their documented effect.
- [ ] Neo light/dark visual checks and the existing pointer/keyboard focus tests cover the new default.

## Out of Scope

Changing selection semantics, per-Body focus ownership, global application focus styles, column widths, or header-gap appearance.

Related: #15195, #9496, #18762 (where the observation surfaced). This is a standalone visual follow-up.
